notes.title: Map Escape, Performance Update, More FPS
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
In this update, we have added more military vehicles to the Escape map. We have also improved the game's performance, so you will now get more FPS in higher graphics settings than before with the same graphics.  

Update log:
1. Performance
1.1 We have improved the game's performance. You will get more FPS. If you are wondering why the game looks a little pixelated in the distance, this is normal due to the optimization for better performance.
2. Escape Map
2.1 We have added more military vehicles to improve the atmosphere. 
2.2 Don't be alarmed, there are now a few loose bodies. Fun tip: you can push the hospital beds around. 
3. Enemies
3.1 The enemies have been visually refreshed with bulletproof vests. 

Rge wishes you a good game and good luck with the missions.

notes.title: Start of development of Operation Zero Hour
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone[/p][p]We hope you are all doing well. After a few weeks of rather minor updates, we want to create new maps and, above all, a story for ShootX with the Operation Zero Hour update. Please excuse the minor updates; everything is a bit overwhelming at the moment. But we are back. There will be new maps. The new maps are tailored precisely to the story. A release date has not yet been set. But we are aiming for before Christmas. For now, we'll just say this much: get ready to save the world and democracy.[/p][p]Important information: There will be fewer updates in the near future, and when updates do come, they will only be bug fixes. We are putting our resources into Operation Zero Hour to create the best maps for our game and for you.[/p][p]Have fun playing, and we'll be back soon.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Small Rework from the Escape Map, More Ammunition
notes.notes: In this update, the Escape map has been embellished with more details. It is now a darker map. With this update, the starting area has been redesigned. In addition, you now have over 300 more balls at your disposal instead of 600 as before, there are now 999 balls. RGE will continue to work on the Escape map, the military base, tent camp and surrounding areas in a further update. RGE is currently working on a larger map that will have more buildings and much more detail. The inspiration comes from the Delta Force campaign. As RGE only has a couple of developers we can't be as fast as others. The map will most likely be released in mid autumn. For more information, please check out the official Instagram account called: RGE. Have fun playing

notes.title: Free demo, full version
notes.notes: [p]We as RGE are forced to raise the price to a few dollars. The most important reason is to give players a better gaming experience, which RGE can only do if it gets money from Steam purchases. The money will not be used for anything that has nothing to do with RGE. It is only meant for the game.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding[/p]

notes.title: June Update
notes.notes: [p]RGE has added a new enemy AI that is smarter. The AI can withstand more but does less damage. The AI can also flank you and see you from a distance. Another feature is that it turns its back on you. We have also added bullet impacts both on the enemies with blood and on other materials with bullet holes. But we have also improved the animation. The magic has been increased from 30 to 40 bullets.[/p][p]Summary:[/p][p]New AI that is smarter[/p][p]Bullets impacts [/p][p]40 Rounds in the Magazin[/p][p]Smoother Reload[/p]

The enemies have been made stronger to maintain the balance. Have fun with the missions. We'll hear from you again soon. The update will be available in 3 days as we still have to test it
